title: Preferent Compression Bounds Are Tight
abstract: arXiv:2609.36030v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The lack of rigorous safety and performance certificates remains a key bottleneck to the deployment of modern learning-based methods. Sample compression has recently emerged as a powerful tool for deriving such certificates, with particularly sharp bounds available for algorithms satisfying a so-called preference property -- also known as stability in the learning theory literature. These bounds find direct application across domains as different as the Scenario Approach, Pick-to-Learn, and Support Vector methods. However, whether they are tight has remained an open problem. In this paper we resolve this question affirmatively and show that the state-of-the-art bound for preferent compressions is provably tight. We establish this by exhibiting an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit. Along the way, we also provide a considerably shorter and more accessible proof

translated_abstract: 缺乏严格的安全性和性能证书仍然是现代基于学习的方法部署的关键瓶颈。样本压缩最近已成为推导此类证书的强大工具，对于满足所谓偏好性质（在学习理论文献中也称为稳定性）的算法，可获得特别尖锐的界。这些界在诸如场景方法、Pick-to-Learn 和支持向量方法等差异巨大的领域中都有直接应用。然而，这些界是否是紧的仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。在本文中，我们肯定地解决了这个问题，并证明了偏好压缩的最先进界是可证明地紧的。我们通过展示一个基于均匀分布和次序统计量的显式构造来确立这一点，该构造在极限情况下达到该界。在此过程中，我们还提供了一个相当简短且更易于理解的证明。
tldr: 本文证明了对满足偏好性质（即稳定性）的算法而言，最先进的样本压缩界是可证明地紧的，其证明方法是通过基于均匀分布和次序统计量的显式构造在极限情况下达到该界。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the state-of-the-art sample compression bounds for algorithms satisfying the preference property (stability) are provably tight, established through an explicit construction based on the uniform distribution and order statistics that attains the bound in the limit.
